en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing an early‑20th‑century urban avenue with tram tracks, overhead trolley wires, pedestrians, and vintage automobiles. On the left are mid‑rise commercial buildings with signs and posters; one large storefront awning reads "GRAN ORIENTAL." On the right dominates an ornate multi‑story building with heavy classical columns, balconies, awnings, and a bustling sidewalk beneath. People in period clothing (hats, long dresses, suits) walk along the street.
